# Android install

## Download
Use the GitHub Release APK (recommended):
https://github.com/robb-devo/ashenwood/releases/latest

Local build output after export:
`dist/android/Ashenwood-debug.apk`

## Install on phone
1. Copy APK to phone (USB, Drive, or download from Releases)
2. Tap APK → Install
3. If blocked: Settings → allow installs from that app/source

## adb install (optional)
```bat
adb install -r Ashenwood-debug.apk
```

Or run `INSTALL_ON_PHONE.bat` with a device connected.
